rawFindings.title: Incorrect URL resolution for relative image paths
rawFindings.explanation: The changed code concatenates the site URL and image path instead of using url.resolve to properly resolve relative URLs against the current page's URL. This breaks handling when the site is hosted in a subdirectory or when the relative path should resolve relative to the current page URL, not always relative to the site root URL.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore using url.resolve(url || config.url, path) to correctly resolve relative image paths against the current page's URL or site URL.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: If the site is hosted under 'http://example.com/blog/' and the page URL is 'http://example.com/blog/foo/bar/index.html', specifying image path 'test.jpg' produces 'http://example.com/blog/test.jpg' instead of expected 'http://example.com/blog/foo/bar/test.jpg', causing incorrect og:image URLs.
